_README: Ledger of stock tips harvested from saved short-form content. This file is EVIDENCE ABOUT THE CONTENT, not a signal source. Every number here whose 'provenance' is 'content' is a claim made in a video and is never treated as equivalent to a figure from a filing. Verdicts on tickers come from tip_intake.py running Erik's own Strategy C rules, never from the video.

promotional_markers.track_record_no_evidence: Claims past wins with no trade log, timeframe, or verifiable record
promotional_markers.specific_entry_prices: Names exact prices to buy at, which converts a narrative into an instruction
promotional_markers.no_position_disclosure: Does not say whether the creator holds the names being pitched
promotional_markers.emotional_or_political_framing: Uses outrage, patriotism, or urgency as support instead of evidence
promotional_markers.no_methodology: No stated rule for how the names were chosen or when to exit

sources.title: Nvidia-Driven AI Investment Picks
sources.substance_note: Cites specific, checkable financial figures. That is what made it auditable, and it is the reason this one is worth more than Video B even though one of its numbers is unsupported.

claims.claim: Marvell acquired Polariton Technologies on April 22, 2026
claims.checked_against: Marvell investor relations press release and trade coverage
Marvell press release and trade coverage

claims.claim: Micron fiscal Q2 2026 revenue nearly tripled to 23.9 billion dollars
claims.checked_against: SEC EDGAR companyfacts, Micron CIK 0000723125, form 10-Q
claims.note: CORRECTED 2026-09-07. An earlier triage marked this WRONG and gave 8.71 billion as the actual figure. The filing says otherwise: the quarter ended 2026-02-26 reported 23.86 billion dollars, and the year-ago quarter ended 2025-02-27 reported 8.05 billion, which is a 2.96x increase. The video is right on both the number and the word 'tripled'. The 8.71 billion figure is fiscal Q1 2025, five quarters earlier.

claims.claim: Micron fiscal Q3 2026 guidance of 33.5 billion dollars
claims.note: Guidance is issued in an earnings release, not tagged in the filings, so it is not checkable from EDGAR alone. What IS checkable: actual fiscal Q3 2026 revenue was 41.46 billion, and the first three quarters of fiscal 2026 total about 78.96 billion. So 33.5 billion is neither the quarterly actual nor a plausible full-year figure for fiscal 2026. Do not repeat this number without the earnings release in hand.
